furthestPublishedNote: The NPUC K-12 education calendar PDF runs to June 2028. The NPUC events calendar itself ends in May 2027 and is mostly committees. The Israel young-adult tour is Oct 25-Nov 2, 2027.
calendarQuality: The union events calendar is an administrators' calendar (GC, NAD and committee meetings) and ends in May 2027. Real union events come from ministry pages (camporee, young adults, DiscipleTrek), the education calendar PDF and Walla Walla University pages.
aheadSummary: The NPUC Pathfinder Camporee is Sep 9-12, 2027 at Grays Harbor County Fairgrounds, Elma, WA (hosted by Washington), with deadlines on Apr 30 (early ticket price), Aug 25 (event staff) and Sep 1 (child-protection screening). Also: Greece young-adult tour (Apr 4-11), WWU University Days, Homecoming and Graduation, the superintendents' retreat, DiscipleTrek (Jul 4-25; apply by May 25), new-teacher cohort and the Fall Leadership Council. OneVoice27 is promoted on the evangelism page but has no union dates.
